events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and Monty Python co-founder John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Python Legend
angles.copy: From 'Monty Python's Flying Circus' to 'Fawlty Towers', John Cleese has given us some of the most iconic comedy moments. Happy 87th birthday to a true legend!

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: Nearly 60 years since its release, The Beatles' 'White Album' remains a sprawling masterpiece. Which track from the double album is your all-time favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year. He passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Voice of a Generation
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury today. His voice, stage presence, and legacy continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Folk-Rock Fusion
angles.copy: 'Rubber Soul' dropped on this day in 1965, showcasing The Beatles' incredible songwriting and musical growth. A true classic, still sounding fresh decades later.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of The Beatles icon John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year. He was tragically killed on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, a visionary artist whose music and message continue to resonate globally. His legacy of peace and love lives on.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of music icon David Bowie, born on January 8, 1947.

angles.name: Starman Legacy
angles.copy: Celebrating the extraordinary life and music of David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. Forever pushing boundaries, forever a star.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today. He was born on January 8, 1935.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. His music still gets us all shook up!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and songwriter Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, his riffs defined an era. What's your favourite Pagey moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock legend Sir Rod Stewart, known for his distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! Six decades in music and still rocking. What's your go-to Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of the iconic British band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Nutty Boy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness! From Camden Town to global fame, his energy is infectious.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, famous for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)' and 'Come Back and Stay', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! His smooth vocals defined the 80s. What's your favourite Paul Young track?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend, singer-songwriter, and businesswoman Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the iconic Dolly Parton! From her incredible music to her philanthropy, she's a true superstar. What's your favourite Dolly moment?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman, singer-songwriter, and record producer Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Leader
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to his solo hits, he's a songwriting powerhouse. What's your favourite Gary track?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of R&B and pop hits in the 70s and 80s, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean! His timeless hits always get us dancing. What's your favourite from the legend?

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame anniversary
events.blurb: The first-ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on January 23, 1986, honouring pioneers like Elvis Presley, Chuck Berry, and James Brown.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: On this day, we're celebrating the anniversary of the first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony. Which artist do you think deserves a spot?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, known for his distinctive vocals and solo work, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! From boyband heartthrob to solo artist, his career has been incredible. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert anniversary
events.blurb: On January 30, 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary and final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Iconic Performance
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. Imagine being there! What's your favourite track from that legendary set?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Grammy and Oscar-winning musician, singer, and songwriter Phil Collins, known for his work with Genesis and a hugely successful solo career, celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Drumming Legend
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the incredible Phil Collins! A true musical powerhouse, whether with Genesis or as a solo artist. What's your favourite Phil track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, actor, and record producer Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Prince of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From 'N Sync to solo superstardom, he's given us so many bangers. What's your favourite JT hit?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic English actor Sir David Jason, beloved for his roles as Del Boy in 'Only Fools and Horses' and Jack Frost in 'A Touch of Frost', celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly!
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A national treasure who has brought so much joy to our screens. What's your favourite Del Boy quote?

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks the 68th anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died' in 1959, when rock and roll stars Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Remembering Legends
angles.copy: On this solemn day, we remember Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. Their music lives on, 68 years after 'The Day The Music Died'.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Rick Astley, famous for his 80s hit 'Never Gonna Give You Up', celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley! Still charming us with that incredible voice and those timeless hits.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Today would have been the 82nd birthday of reggae icon Bob Marley, born on February 6, 1945.

angles.name: One Love Legacy
angles.copy: Celebrating the life and enduring message of Bob Marley, who would have turned 82 today. His music continues to spread peace and unity worldwide.
